sources.title: Pinned Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL BF16 model card
sources.evidence: Exact model card: October 28, 2025 release on Hugging Face and Build; NVIDIA Open Model License; nominal 12.6B size; text, image and video inputs with text output; 128K input plus output context. Card generic Transformer label is refined by the exact model code and technical report.

sources.title: Pinned VL composite model configuration
sources.evidence: Language width 5120/vocabulary 132096, untied embeddings, 62 blocks comprising 28 Mamba, 28 dense MLP and 6 attention; no experts. 131072 maximum sequence and positional settings. C-RADIO ViT-H/16 width 1280 plus 20480-wide connector. No quantization configuration.

sources.title: Complete seven-shard BF16 tensor index
sources.evidence: All 761 indexed tensor names reconciled with bounded headers. Metadata total_size 26363720728 bytes matches the independently checked payload. No exact parameter count is supplied in the index.

sources.title: Bounded headers from all seven BF16 checkpoint shards
sources.evidence: Read every 8-byte prefix and exact JSON header via checked HTTP 206 ranges. All 761 names/shapes/dtypes and contiguous offsets/file lengths verified; 759 BF16 learned tensors contain 13181860352 parameters. Two F32 normalization buffers contain 6 excluded elements. Only 97064 header/prefix bytes downloaded; no weight payload.

sources.title: Pinned vision-language model composition
sources.evidence: Builds language and vision models from configuration; visual pixel shuffle feeds RMSNorm and two bias-free linear projections (5120→20480→5120). EVS and input processing add no learned module weights. Vision preprocessor is externalized; learned vision class tokens remain part of the checkpoint.

sources.title: Pinned language module implementation
sources.evidence: Mamba-2, attention, dense ReLU-squared two-matrix MLP, norms and independent input/output matrices define every language tensor. A_log,D,dt_bias are learned Parameters. There are no MoE/router or MTP modules.

sources.title: Configuration-referenced language remote implementation
sources.evidence: The composite AutoConfig references this repository for the language AutoModel. Compared all source differences against the bundled implementation: cache dtype, support flag, comments and headers differ; learned constructors and their dimensions agree. This is code verification, not transfer of a sibling checkpoint count.

sources.title: Configuration-referenced C-RADIO model construction
sources.evidence: Creates the configured ViT-H/16, removes final norm and classifier, enables conditional positional embeddings and 16 class/register tokens. Empty adaptor names and absent feature-normalizer settings add no learned modules. Runtime summary indices are an integer buffer absent from the release, not parameters.

sources.title: C-RADIO ViT-H definition
sources.evidence: vit_huge_patch16_224 defines 1280 width, 32 layers, 16 heads, patch 16 and no LayerScale override.

sources.title: C-RADIO patch and positional embedding implementation
sources.evidence: Bias-free patch linear has 3*16*16 input channels; learned positions cover(2048/16)^2 positions. Replacement removes original patch/class/position parameters. cls_token helper pads four teacher class tokens to 16 including registers.

sources.title: C-RADIO input normalization buffers
sources.evidence: norm_mean and norm_std are explicitly registered buffers, 3 elements each; excluded from learned count regardless of F32 storage.

sources.title: timm ViT constructor crosscheck
sources.evidence: Inspected this fixed library revision (dependency is not pinned by the model card). Standard ViT defaults: 4x MLP, QKV and projection biases, two learned LayerNorms; no QK norms, pre-norm, LayerScale or extra MLP normalization. Combined with C-RADIO arguments exactly reconstructs all released vision tensors. Attention and Mlp source files were separately read.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL technical report, revision 2
sources.evidence: Latest listed revision Nov 7, 2025. Exact final model combines a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language decoder, RADIO vision encoder and MLP connector. Explicit text, image/video processing, reasoning modes and Glaive/xLAM function-calling SFT. Advertised 128K context is distinct from the 311296 maximum training-sequence length in final context-extension training.

sources.title: Pinned reasoning and tool-call chat template
sources.evidence: Implements /think and /no_think, AVAILABLE_TOOLS, TOOLCALL and TOOL_RESPONSE. Video inputs explicitly disable reasoning and raise when /think is requested; reasoning remains supported for text/image inputs.

sources.title: October 28, 2025 NVIDIA model launch article
sources.evidence: Article body announces the open Nemotron Nano2VL model for text, images and video and links the exact BF16 checkpoint; states hybrid Mamba-Transformer architecture. AI-generated summary was not used as evidence.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement
sources.evidence: Exact governing agreement linked by the BF16 card, headed NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement, last modified October 24, 2025. Distinct from other Nemotron license variants.

sources.title: timm attention implementation crosscheck
sources.evidence: QKV and output projections match the reconstructed shapes; QK/output normalization is disabled by the ViT defaults used by this exact C-RADIO configuration.

sources.title: timm MLP implementation crosscheck
sources.evidence: The standard Mlp has two biased linear layers, hidden dimension four times vision width, with no additional learned normalization for this constructor configuration.

name.note: Readable formatting of the exact model name; BF16 release used as full-precision checkpoint reference.

developer.note: Official NVIDIA model and launch article.

family.note: Explicit Nemotron family identity; canonical lowercase catalog key retained.

release_date.note: Exact card release date and contemporary launch article agree. Later Nov 6/7 report submissions are not model release dates.

open_weights.note: Public official seven-shard checkpoint; all headers accessed without authentication.

license.note: Exact card links this governing agreement; source-code Apache headers do not replace checkpoint terms.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned BF16 checkpoint count 13181860352, independently reconstructed for every tensor. Language 12320486912 + vision 651653120 + connector 209720320. Excludes 6 persistent normalization-buffer elements. The card’s 12.6B is a conflicting nominal label, not this full checkpoint census. No packed weights, quantization scales, MTP or tied duplication.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-parameter count or phase convention is reported for this dense hybrid multimodal model. Do not equate complete learned total with per-token activity: vision encoding and text decoding are separate phases.

architecture.note: Language decoder has 28 Mamba-2, 6 attention and 28 dense MLP blocks. Vision encoder is a 32-layer ViT-H with MLP connector. No routed experts; not a MoE model.

context_window.note: Both max_sequence_length and llm_config.max_position_embeddings are 131072, resolving advertised 128K input+output exactly. Final SFT trained sequences up to 311296; report and card still advertise 128K supported context, so training maximum is not silently substituted.

modalities.note: Explicit text/image/video inputs and generated text output. Video frames share the vision encoder and language context; no audio path.

reasoning.note: Exact report confirms on/off reasoning and template implements controls. Pinned template rejects /think with video input; this input-specific restriction does not negate text/image reasoning support.

tool_call.note: Exact-model report explicitly includes Glaive and xLAM function-calling SFT; template serializes tool schemas,calls and results.

description.value: Vision-language model combining a C-RADIO encoder with a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention decoder, trained for document understanding, video comprehension and reasoning.
description.note: Concrete supported architecture and task description, without comparative performance or generic agentic marketing.

sources.label: Pinned Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL BF16 model card
NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL technical report, revision 2

patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint has 13.181860352B learned parameters, including vision encoder and connector; the model card’s 12.6B label differs from the reconstructed tensor inventory. Normalization buffers are excluded. Separate active parameters are not reported. Supported context is 131072 input-plus-output tokens; the larger 311296-token training sequence length is not advertised as the inference context. Reasoning is supported for text/image inputs; the pinned chat template disables reasoning for video.

checkpoint_audit.note: Complete BF16 learned checkpoint. Nominal card 12.6B differs; independently reconstructed count is authoritative for this pinned full checkpoint. No routed experts; active count not separately disclosed.
checkpoint_audit.method: Checked HTTP 206 Content-Range,length,contiguous dtype-sized offsets,physical shard lengths,index membership. Independently enumerated every expected name/shape from configuration and enabled constructors; all 761 matched. No model execution or weight payload downloads.
checkpoint_audit.runtime_constructor_audit: No extra learned constructor families found in the enabled configuration. RADIO final norm/classifier are removed; original patch/class/positions are replaced; optional adaptors/feature normalizers disabled; default LayerScale,QK normalization,pre-norm and MLP normalization are identity. Three runtime summary-index integers are derived buffers absent from the checkpoint. Vision preprocessing/EVS has no learned parameters. Language remote source constructor definitions match bundled source. timm 1.0.20 was a fixed crosscheck, not a model-pinned dependency. Although the saved arguments include force_spectral_reparam=true, spectral_reparam=false and neither active hf_model.py nor create_model_from_args calls the imported configure_spectral_reparam_from_args function; no reparametrization tensors or scaling parameters are introduced.

summary: All 14 fields audited. Correct total to independently reconstructed complete 13.181860352B, architecture to hybrid SSM/Transformer, governing license and exact 131072 context. Confirm Oct 28 release, text/image/video,reasoning and tool training. Keep active unknown because no separate activity accounting is published; record nominal-card size discrepancy, training-context distinction and video reasoning restriction.
